Azobenzene, C6H5-N=N-C6H5, has two distinct configurations about its N=N bond, cis and trans. The structures below are stationary points of its potential energy surface at omega-B97x/6-31G(d), taken from a published kinetic transition network in which every minimum and every transition state was located and verified by Hessian analysis. You are setting up a transition-state refinement for the pathway in which one nitrogen inverts in the plane of the fragment, and need a starting geometry that already shows that distortion: one C-N=N angle opened towards 180 degrees, and the two C-N bonds no longer equal, because the inverting nitrogen shortens its own C-N bond. The four attached files candidate-1.xyz to candidate-4.xyz are four stationary points of the same published network, in no particular order (rows counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines; the fragment is C6 (row 6) - N13 (row 13) = N14 (row 14) - C15 (row 15)). Required: (opened angle) one of the two C-N=N angles is at least 160 degrees; (C-N asymmetry) the two C-N bond lengths differ by at least 0.05 angstrom. Exactly one of the four meets every requirement. Which candidate should you take?

选项：
A. candidate-1
B. candidate-2
C. candidate-3
D. candidate-4

附件：candidate-1.xyz、candidate-2.xyz、candidate-3.xyz、candidate-4.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：四个附件都是 Landscape17 已发表的坐标，附件名与顺序不含信息；只依据题干给出的几何目标与所给坐标作答。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
